Challenges

Sound familiar?

“The same product shows up at five different URLs.”

Shopify’s collections and tags generate duplicates by design. A canonical rulebook plus internal linking neutralises most of the damage without fighting the platform.

“Our collections have no copy — or walls of it that hurt shopping.”

Collection copy is written to rank and to sell: keyword-mapped, scannable, and placed so it never pushes products below the fold.

“An SEO agency gave us fixes Shopify can’t do.”

Every recommendation here is platform-native — if Shopify cannot do it, we find the workaround Shopify can.

“Our store is slow and rankings slipped.”

App bloat and theme weight are the usual causes. The speed and app report shows exactly what to remove, defer or replace.

“Product pages rank, then vanish when variants change.”

Variant and out-of-stock handling is part of the rulebook — URLs, canonicals and internal links stay stable as the catalogue changes.

“We migrated to Shopify and lost our traffic.”

Migration losses are usually redirect and structure gaps. We audit what the move broke and rebuild the equity page by page.

“Blog content exists but brings no buyers.”

Shopify blogs are re-mapped to collections and products with internal links, so content supports revenue pages instead of floating alone.

“We can’t tell if SEO is making money.”

Reporting is organic revenue by collection and product — not just sessions — so priorities follow margin, not vanity metrics.

How It Works

Shopify SEO is its own discipline

Forced URL structures, duplicate content from collections and tags, limited control over sitemaps and robots — Shopify stores face SEO problems other platforms never see.

We specialise in working inside those constraints: canonical strategy for collection duplicates, structured data beyond the theme defaults, app-stack audits that protect speed, and content systems that turn a product catalogue into a traffic engine.

  • Shopify SEO audit
  • Collection & keyword map
  • Canonical rulebook
  • Schema implementation
  • Speed & app report
  • Organic revenue reporting

FAQs

FAQs on Shopify SEO services

Can you fix Shopify's duplicate content?

We cannot change Shopify's URL structure, but canonical strategy, internal linking and parameter control neutralise most of the damage.

Do you work with our theme?

Yes — changes are theme-safe and tested; we coordinate with your developer where needed.

Which apps do you recommend?

Only what the audit justifies — every app costs speed, so the stack stays lean.

How fast will rankings move?

Collection fixes often show within a crawl cycle or two; competitive terms build over 3–6 months.

Do you work with Shopify Plus?

Yes — Plus stores get the same platform-native program, with checkout extensibility and multi-storefront structures handled in the audit.

Will SEO work slow down our store or break the theme?

Changes are staged and tested; speed work removes weight rather than adding it, and nothing ships to the live theme unreviewed.
